collection.title: SEAT Exeo 2008 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the SEAT Exeo Hatchback 2008 to 2013 will fit, this model requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Slider arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Exeo which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
